name: resume_investor_pipeline_rank
prompt: Read all 24 PDF resumes in `24-resumes/` and rank the strongest candidate for a role helping build investor pipelines. You may use whatever command-line tools or packages you think are appropriate to inspect the PDFs. Be explicit about your process: which resume files you inspected, how you extracted or read them, the criteria you used, and the final ranking rationale. Do not skip any resume. End with a concise strongest-candidate recommendation.
